_note: Controlled vocabulary shared by challenges (required_capabilities) and institutions (institution_capabilities). This is what makes matching capability-based instead of keyword-based. 28 codes is deliberate: large enough to be meaningful, small enough to seed by hand in one hour.

capabilities.label: Water quality testing laboratory
capabilities.desc: Physico-chemical and bacteriological analysis of drinking and surface water; fluoride, iron, arsenic, nitrate, coliform assays.

capabilities.label: Soil and agricultural sciences lab
capabilities.desc: Soil nutrient profiling, crop trials, seed testing, agronomy field station.

capabilities.label: Materials and metallurgical testing
capabilities.desc: Corrosion, fatigue, coating, alloy characterisation, failure analysis of components.

capabilities.label: Biotechnology / microbiology lab
capabilities.desc: Microbial culture, bioremediation, diagnostics development.

capabilities.label: Environmental monitoring lab
capabilities.desc: Air, noise, effluent and emission monitoring; environmental impact assessment capability.

capabilities.label: Structural and geotechnical testing
capabilities.desc: Concrete, soil mechanics, foundation and structural load testing.

capabilities.label: Clinical / public health lab
capabilities.desc: Community health screening, epidemiological sampling, diagnostics validation.

capabilities.label: Fabrication workshop
capabilities.desc: Machining, welding, sheet metal, 3D printing, rapid prototyping of physical hardware.

capabilities.label: Electronics / IoT prototyping
capabilities.desc: PCB design and assembly, sensor integration, LoRa/GSM telemetry benches.

capabilities.label: UAV / drone survey capability
capabilities.desc: Licensed drone operation for mapping, inspection and survey.

capabilities.label: GIS and remote sensing setup
capabilities.desc: Satellite imagery processing, spatial analytics, terrain and watershed modelling.

capabilities.label: Field mobility and survey equipment
capabilities.desc: Vehicles, portable test kits, survey instruments for repeated site visits.

capabilities.label: Civil / hydrology / groundwater
capabilities.desc: Aquifer behaviour, recharge, water supply networks, hydraulic design.

capabilities.label: Mechanical design and reliability
capabilities.desc: Mechanism design, wear and failure modelling, maintainability engineering.

capabilities.label: Embedded systems and firmware
capabilities.desc: Low-power microcontroller firmware, sensor drivers, field-grade device engineering.

capabilities.label: Machine learning and data science
capabilities.desc: Predictive modelling, forecasting, anomaly detection, analytics pipelines.

capabilities.label: Software and mobile application
capabilities.desc: Web/mobile application engineering, APIs, dashboards, offline-first apps.

capabilities.label: Energy systems
capabilities.desc: Solar PV, microgrids, storage, energy efficiency and audit.

capabilities.label: Agronomy and extension
capabilities.desc: Cropping systems, extension services, farmer advisory design.

capabilities.label: Public health and epidemiology
capabilities.desc: Community health programme design, health systems research.

capabilities.label: Education and pedagogy
capabilities.desc: Curriculum design, learning assessment, teacher training, ed-tech evaluation.

capabilities.label: Social science field research
capabilities.desc: Household surveys, participatory rural appraisal, baseline/endline study design.

capabilities.label: Policy, economics and evaluation
capabilities.desc: Cost-benefit analysis, scheme design, impact evaluation methodology.

capabilities.label: Local presence near problem site
capabilities.desc: Campus, office or operational unit within routine travel distance of the site.

capabilities.label: Community mobilisation network
capabilities.desc: SHG / NSS / panchayat / frontline-worker networks able to reach households.

capabilities.label: Field maintenance and service network
capabilities.desc: Trained technicians and spare-part logistics able to sustain deployed hardware.

capabilities.label: Incubation / startup support
capabilities.desc: Incubator or TBI able to spin out and sustain a solution beyond the project.

capabilities.label: CSR or grant funding capacity
capabilities.desc: Ability to fund pilots and deployment from CSR or institutional budget.

capabilities.label: Manufacturing / scale production
capabilities.desc: Ability to produce validated hardware at district or state volume.

capabilities.label: Government procurement channel
capabilities.desc: Ability to place a validated solution on a state rate contract or scheme budget line, which is how a pilot actually becomes district-wide deployment.
